feature_plan.decision_rule: Use the primary paired difference, interval, training-fold consistency and cost together. An interval crossing zero is inconclusive, not evidence of equivalence. Negative results complete Q5.

evaluation.bootstrap_method: class-stratified paired percentile bootstrap, conditional on fitted models and split
evaluation.calibration: sigmoid, 3 stratified shuffled training-only folds, ensemble=False; full feature pipeline inside calibrator
evaluation.inner_metric: raw-margin AUROC, diagnostic only; no tuning

feature_plan.hypothesis: Character n-grams may contribute complementary local writing-form information; this mechanism is unverified.
limitations: The canonical validation set already informed Q1 development; this is a development comparison, not an untouched final test.
Intervals omit training variation and selection adjustment.
W120 is a feature-budget reference, not a strict isolation of effective model capacity.
Fixed C and normalization permit a controlled representation comparison, not a claim that all geometry or regularization effects are identical.
Character features may encode source-specific shortcuts; hidden-domain robustness remains unverified.
feature_plan.purpose: Frozen Q5 representation ablation, authorized after discussion and before any Q5 scores
feature_plan.question: Does adding character TF-IDF improve the fixed Q1 word-TF-IDF SVM?
feature_plan.stopping_rule: Complete exactly these four fixed configurations. Do not add ranges, weights, classifiers, or C searches after seeing results. Fault recovery may resume identical unfinished steps.
